question: The world famous Kathak dancer Pandit Birju Maharaj was the face of the KalkaBindadin gharana of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world famous Kathak dancer Pandit Birju Maharaj was the face of the KalkaBindadin **gharana of Lucknow.**
 
• The **Lucknow Gharana was established under the patronage of Wajid Ali Shah,** the last Nawab of Oudh.
